title: Point cloud to Revit, two storeys
text: Synthetic scan of a two-storey house: levels, walls, doors with swing side, windows, floors and rooms, created natively in Revit 2025 through the MCP. All checks pass.

title: Curved walls with openings
text: A curved bay found in the scan by a circle fit: radius exact in Revit, a door and a window placed in the curved wall.

title: Stairs and slab openings
text: A straight stair from rising tread patches and the slab void above it, cut into the upper floor.

title: 2D plan (vector PDF) to Revit
text: Floor plan of the ground floor rebuilt from a vector PDF at 1:100: walls from paired face lines, doors from swing arcs, windows from glass lines, the stair from its tread lines.

title: plan-extract result to Revit
text: Two storeys from plan-extract results (BBL's reader for raster plans): wall centre lines with thickness, openings on their host walls, the void over the stair.
